instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the audio player as a sticky bar at the bottom using the 'player_bar' surface styles.
Never use pure black (#000000) or generic gray; strictly use the tinted palette provided (#0A0A0B and #141417).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='play-button', data-testid='upload-podcast-form').
The UI should feel like a premium command center for creators and a moody lounge for listeners.
Avoid standard 'Bootstrap' columns. Use generous bento grids and robust spacing defined in the guidelines.
Do not use generic HTML inputs; customize Shadcn components to match the dark/amber theme and rounded radii.
